hypothesis: Outcome-adaptive sparse-program disagreement plus observable-feature separation improves correctly answered query-blind rare five-factor causal questions over exact fixed32 and independent seeded random32 schedules, using the same unchanged four-term tokenless WSP143 learner, same 32 actual charged consequences and shared held queries selected only AFTER all actions and all 64 predictions are frozen.
experiment_scope: NEW PUBLIC SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT ONLY; not original DTR/CausalGym/MDP source first-use, not native Yggdrasil scientific admission or real-world causal discovery.

source.namespace: WSP145|SOURCE|FAMILY|SEED distinct from all WSP144 260xxx and prior cohorts
forbidden: all historical WSP-135..144 source namespaces and scored cohorts
original DTR, MDP, CausalGym or native scientific first-use
source.law: Independent source-private generator with six Boolean factors, hidden fresh SHA256 role permutation, same public AND/XOR family definitions as WSP144; no truth imported in policy/learner.
source.public_to_policy: 64 legal typed inputs x=0..63, stable opaque public law_id, own earlier real queried x/effects only; NO future held query coordinates, family, hidden source law, seed-derived role identity, other-arm outcomes or oracle.
source.source_owner_private: truth, final per-world query-blind 8-point held set, scoring, and per-arm charge ledger

design.shared_warmstart: First 20 inputs of unchanged WSP135 exact fixed32 schedule for all 3 arms, same source consequences charged independently per arm.
design.fixed: Complete unchanged WSP135 fixed32 sequence (20 shared plus remaining 12).
design.random: After shared 20, choose 12 remaining x ranked by SHA256('WSP145|RANDOM|law_id|x'); no private source or reward access beyond shared 20.
design.adaptive: After shared 20, for each next action t=21..32 recompute source-blind exact sparse-program candidates from own t-1 observations, with supplied generic AND/XOR six-factor concept lattice; for depths 2..5 call same mathematical minimum-term/minimum-degree <=4-term exact solver as unchanged WSP143, but partial-row interface authored only under WSP-145. Preserve all equal-best programs up to 10000 per depth. At each unqueried x, compute equal-stage-weight vote probability p for outcome=1 across retained exact-fit programs; choose greatest p*(1-p), then greatest number of currently indistinguishable feature-signature pairs split by x, then public deterministic SHA256('WSP145|TIE|law_id|x') order. If no candidates or overflow at all depths, structural split-only fallback. No scored holdout information or true law prior.
design.structural_split: For all generic degree<=5 AND masks m in 0..63, partition by their signatures over previously observed input x; score x as sum over each signature class (#m activated by x)*(#m not activated by x). Computes distinguishability of observationally aliased features, not hidden ground truth.
design.adaptive_ablations: Source-blind structural-split-only schedule from same warm 20 may be evaluated as a fourth separately charged arm only with its own prospective dedicated source budget and new prereg; NOT silently add to this three-arm primary. Offline non-source signature diagnostics allowed.
design.held_selection: Only AFTER all 3 arms freeze 32 action coordinates AND all 64 output predictions, owner computes intersection of all three never-paid x. At least 8 remain because 20 shared warm plus <=12 unique tail x per arm implies union <=56. Pick EXACT 8 by SHA256('WSP145|HELD|law_id|x') ranking from intersection. Learners and selectors never receive these x before their 64 prediction vectors are sealed. The held selection depends on action locations, NEVER on hidden labels; disclose this post-selection limitation.
design.paired_unit: World/seed, not eight correlated questions, is the independent unit. Same eight held x per world for every arm/control. 32 FIVE worlds x8 =256 paired FIVE questions. Other each 8 x8 =64.
design.query_blind: Future x not revealed during acquisition, training or prediction, and not paid by any arm; this is within-law query-blind interpolation/extrapolation over public six-bit input universe, not unfamiliar new world/domain transfer.
design.budgets: Exactly 32 observed public intervention effects per arm/world; 3 arms x64 worlds x32 =6144, plus ZERO original protected effects and ZERO cold-relabeled source calls.

learner_and_controls.primary: EXACT WSP143 concepts.fit(rows) and predict on final 32 rows, no changes to WSP143 model or source; source-blind data only.
learner_and_controls.independent_equal_prior_symbolic: EXACT WSP143 flat_control symbolic_fit/predict, same arm inputs, must tie every x at all worlds/arms, proving no unique hierarchical vs exact symbolic benefit if tied.
learner_and_controls.conventional: Unchanged fully-fitted WSP135 CART trained to its existing convergence contract independently on each arm's same 32 actual effects.
learner_and_controls.original_direct: Unchanged WSP142 direct three-term fit/predict on same inputs.
learner_and_controls.other: Unchanged WSP135 latent and no-update all-abstain; source-private truth never enters fits. Cold restore of original state after later worlds, 8 relabeled old laws, 8x64=512 identity predictions per arm, no source queries.
learner_and_controls.negative_controls: OFF structureless laws must not generate confident false causal claims; wrong-confident, abstentions, total correct separately reported.

frozen_metrics.five_primary: FIVE correct /256, wrong_confident /256, abstained /256 on same hidden-after-commit 8x32 selected x.
frozen_metrics.whole_process_cost: Return per-arm acquisition+fit+64-readout CPU/wall, peak traced memory, source calls, total charged effects, algorithmic timing, and original unchanged conventional fit costs; do not claim energy/FLOP superiority without measurement.

safety_and_custody.freeze_first: Prereg in sole-file initial commit BEFORE any WSP145 source, candidate code, scoring, or new output/seed first use; do not modify after.
safety_and_custody.source_first_use: Public fresh synthetic ONLY after prereg+source-independent qualification; original protected source first use DENIED.
safety_and_custody.source_isolation: new WSP-145 source custodian file is independent from policy and learner modules; owner scores only after frozen prediction vectors; guards reject protected/replayed/over-budget calls
